title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: In a logistic regression model, the function \( \sigma(z) \) is the sigmoid function, which maps any real-valued number into the range $$(0,1)$$. The expression \( $$\theta_0+\theta_1 x$$ \) is the linear combination of the parameters and the feature. Think about how changes in \( $$x$$ \) affect the value of \( $$\theta_1$$ \).

title: Exploring the Role of \( $$\theta_1$$ \)
text: The parameter \( $$\theta_1$$ \) in the logistic regression model represents the change in the log-odds of the response variable for a one-unit change in \( $$x$$ \). Consider how the sign and magnitude of \( $$\theta_1$$ \) influence the direction and steepness of the curve.
